invariants: No recovery step creates a second owner for an existing responsibility.
Raw archives, summaries, cloud exchange, and Environment payloads remain outside installer repair scope.
The historical failed candidate and its evidence remain immutable.
Diagnostics cannot write host product resources and cannot substitute for complete packaged-chain evidence.
Production editing begins only after exact root-cause proof and targets the nearest false boundary.
Deletion requires prior reachability, package-membership, owner-overlap, replacement, and test proof.
A failure invalidates the earliest contradicted receipt and its dependants, not unrelated completed work.
S09 freezes one committed source and one installer; S13 through S15 evaluate, install, and publish those same bytes without rebuilding.
authority_withheld: production repair beyond the current step
